## Abstract

The ITSM Operations Architecture domain encompasses decisions related to IT service management, operational vendor relationships, infrastructure operations, monitoring and alerting systems, and operational security frameworks. This domain ensures reliable, secure, and efficient operations of enterprise technology services while maintaining appropriate vendor partnerships and operational governance.

ITSM Operations architecture decisions directly impact service availability, operational efficiency, vendor risk management, and the overall operational resilience of enterprise technology services.
